definition: v1 uses frozen v1 event mechanisms with training-only rebuilt old cards and season MPG. v3-signals-off retains all v3 event accounting/timing/foul/turnover mechanisms and disables only learned DREB/rim/liveTOV/zone/FTA signals. Both use the frozen seven-batch pooled training calibration algorithm (3 seeds, at most5 iterations), initial pace1; no net/win tuning. Pure signal attribution is v3 versus signals-off; v3 versus v1 also changes accounting/events/timing and is not a pure defense signal attribution.
